titleTag: In transit, confirmed at the door, and settled with the vendor by hand.

captions.text: Rep logs it as "in transit" — not at the warehouse yet
Pick the vendor and the fish, kg promised
Admin signs in to receive it at the door
Confirm arrivals — what's still in transit
Measure what actually arrived: good kg, spoiled kg
Short of what was promised — flagged for reconciliation
Reconcile the bill by hand with the vendor
Settled — physical stock and the bill stay separate, on purpose

closeTag: What's on the shelf is what was measured — what's owed is a conversation with the vendor.
